verdict.rationale: Azure runs a public status page that says it notifies users of outages and points them to Azure Service Health for further issues (azure-docs-18, azure-docs-31). However, a community report filed during a specific multi-region outage says the status page stayed green and that its link to Service Health led to an Azure Portal page that was itself down (azure-comm-2). That concretely contradicts the claim that outages are surfaced publicly. Missing for 10: evidence of per-service incident history, published post-incident reports, and independent confirmation that the status page reflects real outages in a timely way.
